title: God's Colorful World Quiz
description: Let's see what you learned about art and discovery in God's colorful world!

questions.question: Why did God put a rainbow in the sky?
options: As a promise to never flood the whole earth again
questions.explanation: God put the rainbow in the sky as a promise to Noah that He would never flood the whole earth again (Genesis 9:13).

questions.question: What can you see inside a leaf when you do a leaf rubbing?
options: The veins and pattern of the leaf
questions.explanation: Leaf rubbings show the veins and patterns that God designed inside each leaf!

questions.question: What is a ramp?
options: A flat surface that goes up to help move things
questions.explanation: A ramp is a flat surface that goes up. It helps us move heavy things more easily. God gave people wisdom to create tools like ramps!

questions.question: What happens when you put a leaf in water?
questions.explanation: Leaves are light, so they float on water! God designed water in amazing ways.

questions.question: The Bible says God is like a potter and we are like what?
questions.explanation: The Bible says we are the clay and God is the potter. He shapes us with love and care (Isaiah 64:8)!

questions.question: What makes a shadow?
questions.explanation: A shadow is made when an object blocks the light. God created light on the very first day of creation (Genesis 1:3)!
